title: An Angler's Workbench
description:
Alright, looks like you've got some experience under your belt. I'm sure you're ready to jump into the deep end. Well, say no more, and let me introduce you to the [Angling Table](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/angling_table.png:124:62). This will be your ticket to customizing your rod further, adding all sorts of hooks, bobbers, and lines.
Opening the angling table's ui, [you'll see just what I described](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/angling_table_gui.png:124:58). A slot on the left for you to put your rod into, along with three slots on the right, each corresponding to one of the three attachments.
